# GMEOW Sensory Environment Module

The GMEOW Sensory Environment Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/sensory-environment>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/sensory-environment`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

Ambient perceivable conditions at a Location×time. Measured conditions are expressed as CoordinateMatrix values in measurement reference frames (colourspace, audio spectrum, thermal, air-quality). Perceived conditions are standpoint-indexed values in MentalReferenceFrames. Part of the #42 Location-as-reference-frame epic. Consumes OBS + #43 + R6. Putative.

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/sensory-environment>
